description: This Java class 'PersistedServiceJob' extends 'GenericServiceJob' and manages scheduled jobs stored in the 'JobSandbox' entity within the Apache OFBiz framework. It handles job queuing, initialization, recurrence scheduling, failure retries, and context retrieval, with detailed logging and error handling.

classes.name: PersistedServiceJob
classes.description: A job class that manages scheduled, persisted service jobs within the OFBiz framework, supporting recurrence, retries, and context management.

methods.name: PersistedServiceJob
methods.description: Constructor initializing the job with context, job data, and requester, parsing run time and retry info.

methods.name: queue
methods.description: Queues the job for execution, updating status and verifying instance ownership.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes job state, sets start time, manages recurrence, and schedules next execution if applicable.

methods.name: createRecurrence
methods.description: Creates a new job recurrence entry for the next scheduled run.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Marks job as finished, records result or error message.

methods.name: failed
methods.description: Handles job failure, manages retries, and updates status.

methods.name: getServiceName
methods.description: Retrieves the service name associated with the job.

methods.name: getContext
methods.description: Builds and returns the execution context for the job, including user login info.

methods.name: getRetries
methods.description: Counts the number of retries for the job based on failed attempts.

methods.name: canRetry
methods.description: Determines if the job can be retried based on maxRetry and currentRetryCount.

methods.name: getRecurrenceInfo
methods.description: Fetches recurrence information associated with the job.

methods.name: deQueue
methods.description: Removes the job from the queue, resetting its state.

methods.name: getStartTime
methods.description: Returns the scheduled start time of the job.

methods.name: getPriority
methods.description: Returns the job's priority, defaulting if not set.
